limitations: The new native route declares a different hypothetical 6 mm access window and named research tool; it is not a silent repair of an original route.
Policy action scope is STOP versus the declared native stroke; no free-form trajectory was learned.
This is selection-only interface validation. No final-evaluation world was used and no superiority over search is established.
Distinct optimization and selection seeds use nominal zero-shift native anatomy; this does not establish robustness to registration or anatomical uncertainty.
Accessible target estimates and simulated removed cells remain separate; contact and removal surrogates are not clinical injury probabilities.
Learner budget excludes separately measured preparation and independent certification.
Concurrent integration testing and packaging affected shared CPU load; elapsed time is descriptive workflow timing, not a comparative benchmark.
